questions.q: Which mode must always be on a separate switch on a fixed wing?
questions.explain: Direct control of the servos is the last resort.

options: P and I for roll and pitch
questions.explain: Autotune does not touch P and I — they are tuned by hand.

questions.q: In which mode does autotune not work?
questions.explain: In MANUAL there is no stabilization — there is nothing to tune.

questions.q: What is the NAV LAUNCH autolaunch for?
options: The motor starts after the throw
For RTH after a link loss
questions.explain: Throw detection from acceleration, a smooth throttle ramp.

questions.q: The wing loses altitude in a climb in navigation. What do you check?
questions.explain: nav_fw_cruise_thr and nav_fw_max_thr: a low cruise throttle means a stall in the climb.

questions.q: How do you check for reversed elevons before the flight?
questions.explain: The surfaces must oppose the tilt; if they help it — reverse in the mixer.

options: A pitch angle of 10° in the climb

questions.q: What detects the throw in autolaunch?
questions.explain: Then the motor delay and the launch throttle.
